Text: On a diplomatic trip to {d(Ruler)}'s territory, your shuttle overshoots a starlane exit into the outer reaches of {StarSystem}

You find yourself in orbit above an uninteresting dwarf planet. But as you’re about to leave, sensors pick up a structure beneath the surface. 

Landing to investigate, you discover a smooth megalith. Stretched out behind it, half-buried in millennia of rock, is a titanic black pyramid.

You summon a covert science team; after a hurried investigation, they report their readings are "perplexing". Does {d(Ruler)} need to know about this discovery?

You find yourself lying in a sarcophagus, lined with needles and metallic tubing. It’s filling with blood - your blood? You feel weak.

You open your mouth, and speak to yourself without willing it.
“You shattered my icons," you drone. "Desecrated my temple. I will take great pleasure sucking the flesh from your bones.”
